propositions: The bugfix-size gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) unless they carry a plan-review attestation signed by a pinned environment, but only the prod op-cert environment is pinned and has no accessible client.

A developer's locally-signed plan review generates an unpinned DSSE principal, which triggers the not-pinned arm and returns verdict mismatch, classifying the gate as blocking despite the review passing.

The op-cert service accepts plan-review attestation requests but lacks a repo client to call it, cannot persist returned envelopes, and requires a production secret (X-Opcert-Guard header) to succeed.

The attestation check was gated on the source of certification (who signed) rather than the fact of certification (that a review occurred), making it unsatisfiable for any contributor without Gerrit-gated pinning.

The fix removes provenance verification (trusted_env_keyring lookup and verify_opcert call) and re-implements subject binding as an explicit step, accepting attestations based on completion and lifecycle validity rather than signer identity.
